title: A Coordinate System for Collatz Dynamics
summary: It is well-established that every odd positive integer $n$ can be written uniquely as $n = λ\cdot 2^a \cdot 3^b - 1$ where $\gcd(λ, 6) = 1$ and $a \geq 1$. Building from this 3-smooth factorization, we introduce a partition of the nonnegative integers into countably many infinite triangles where each row $k$ forms a Collatz chain of alternating parity. The partition admits a coordinate system as a skeleton $\mathcal{L}_λ$ using the pair $(a, b)$ for odd positive integers within a geometric structure where row $k$ corresponds to $k = a + b$.
